questions.question:
The given bar graph indicates the production of sugar (in lakh tonnes) by three different sugar companies P, Q and R from the year 2015 to 2019. Study the bar graph and answer the question that follows.

Production of sugar by companies P, Q and R from 2015 to 2019

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54aa41ee9c0a398aab263963a0f8c3d0dfd4f5893a609f84b84b537fd227dc22.png] 

The percentage increase in the production of sugar by company P in 2019 as compared to 2015 is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Production of company P in 2015 = 80 lakh tonnes

Production of company P in 2019 = 120 lakh tonnes

**Calculation:**

∴ The required percentage increase in 2019 = (120 - 80)/80 × 100

**⇒ 40/80 × 100 = 50%**

questions.question: 2 cos θ + sec θ - 2√2 = 0, where θ is an acute angle. Find the value of θ.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

2 cos θ + sec θ - 2√2 = 0

⇒ 2 cos θ + 1/ cos θ - 2√2 = 0

⇒ 2 cos² θ + 1 - 2√2 cos θ = 0

⇒ 2 cos2 θ - 2√2 cos θ + 1 = 0

⇒ 2 cos2 θ - √2 cos θ - √2 cos θ + 1 = 0

⇒ √2 cos θ (√2 cos θ - 1) - 1(√2 cos θ - 1) = 0

⇒ (√2 cos θ - 1)² = 0

⇒ √2 cos θ - 1 = 0

⇒ √2 cos θ = 1 

⇒ cos θ = 1/√2 

∴ cos 45° = 1/√2 

**⇒ θ = 45°**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** By value putting:

θ = 45° 

2 cos θ + sec θ - 2√2 = 0 

⇒ 2 × 1/√2 + √2 - 2√2 = 0 

⇒ 2√2 - 2√2 = 0

**At values θ = 30° , 60° and 15°, the above condition is not fulfilled. Hence, 45° is the correct value of θ.**

questions.question: If x⁴+(1)/(x⁴)=6887, then the positive value of x-(1)/(x) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

 x⁴+(1)/(x⁴)=6887

If x² + 1/x² = a, then x - 1/x = sqrt{a - 2} 

**Calculation:**

** x⁴+(1)/(x⁴)=6887**

By adding 2 on both sides. 

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x4 + 2 = 6887 + 2

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 6889

⇒( x² + 1/x²) = sqrt{6889} = 83 = a 

Now, x - 1/x = sqrt{83 - 2} = 9

questions.question: A truck covers a distance of 480 km at a certain speed. If the speed is decreased by 8 km/h, it would have taken 2 hours more to cover the same distance. 50% of its original speed (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance cover = 480 km

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let the speed be = x km/h

**According to the question:**

480 km/(x - 8) - 480 km/x = 2 hours

⇒ 1/(x - 8) - 1/x = 2/480 

⇒ x - x + 8/(x - 8)x = 1/240

⇒ 8 × 240 = x² - 8x 

⇒ x² - 8x - 1920 =0 

⇒ x² + 40x - 48x - 1920 = 0

⇒ x(x + 40) - 48(x + 40) = 0

⇒ x ≠ - 40, x = 48

**∴ 50% of the original speed = 48 × 1/2 = 24 km/h**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** By hit and trial method:

Option 1: 480/(2× 24 - 8) - 480/2× 24 = 12 - 10 = 2 hours

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio (1)/(4) ∶ (5)/(9) ∶ (7)/(12). The difference between the greatest and the smallest number is 180. Find the sum of all the three numbers.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of three numbers = (1)/(4) ∶ (5)/(9) ∶ (7)/(12)

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be = A, B & C

By taking the LCM of the denominators of the fractions.

LCM (4, 9, 12) = 36

⇒ 9/36 : 5×4/36 : 7×3/36

⇒ A : B : C = 9 : 20 : 21

∵ C - A = 21 - 9 = 12 = 180 

∴ A + B + C = 9 + 20 + 21 = 50 = 180/12 × 50

**⇒ 15 × 50 = 750**

questions.question: Working together, A, B and C can finish a piece of work in 3 hours. A finishes the same work in 8 hours and B finishes it in 6 hours. How long will it take for C alone to finish the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No of days taken by A, B & C = 3 hours 

No of days taken by A = 8 hours

No of days taken by B = 6 hours 

**Formula used:**

Time = Total work/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be the LCM of 3, 8, and 6 = 24 units 

No of hours Work Efficiency 

A + B + C = 3 hours 8 

A = 8 hours 24 units 3

B = 6 hours 4 

⇒ C's efficiency = 8 - 3 - 4 = 1 unit per day 

**∴ The required no of hours taken by C = 24/1 = 24 hours **

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs.1,280. If a shopkeeper sold the article at 12% profit after giving 30% discount, then the cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marker Price (MP) = Rs.1280

Profit % = 12

Discount % = 30

**Formulas used:**

Discount % = Discount/MP × 100

Profit % = Profit/Cost Price × 100

Selling Price = Marked Price - Discount

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

Cost Price = (Selling price × 100)/(100 + profit)

**Calculation:**

Discount % = Discount/1280 × 100 

⇒ 30 = Discount/1280 × 100

⇒ Discount = 128 × 3 = Rs.384

Selling Price = 1280 - 384 = Rs.896

Cost Price = (Selling price × 100)/(100 + profit)

⇒ (896 × 100)/(100 + 12)

**∴ CP = 89600/112 = Rs.800 **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method**

Cost Price = MP × (100 - D)/100 × 100/(100 + P)

⇒ Rs.1280 × 70/100 × 100/112 = Rs.800

questions.question: If a nine-digit number 1263487xy is divisible by both 8 and 5, then the greatest possible values of x and y, respectively, are:
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Divisibility by 8 = A number is divisible by 8 when the number formed by the last three digits of the number is divisible by 8.

Divisibility by 5 = A number is divisible by 5 if the last digit ends with 0 or 5.

**Calculation:**

For y = 5, 0

If we take y = 5, the number becomes odd. An odd number is not divisible by 8.

So, the value of y has to be 0.

For x = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9

By taking x = 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9 and dividing the last three digits by 8, we get remainders in each case. So, x cannot take these numbers.

By taking x = 2, 6 and dividing the last three digits by 8, we get 0 as the remainder.

But for the maximum value of x, we need to take x = 6.

**∴ 126348760 is the required number that is divisible by 8 with the greatest values of x = 6 and y = 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

By hit and trial method:

**Option 1:** x = 2, y = 0 satisfy the divisibility but doesn't have greatest value of x.

**Option 2:** x = 6, y = 0 satisfies the divisibility by both 8 and 5 and also have greatest values of x and y. 

**Option 3: **x = 2, y = 5 doesn't satisfy the divisibility by 8.

**Option 4:** x = 6, y = 5 doesn't satisfy the divisibility by 8.

**∴ Option 2 has the required values.**

questions.question: The simple interest on a certain sum for 3 years at 12% p.a. is Rs.6,750. What is the compound interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for 2 years at 20% p.a., if interest is compounded half-yearly? (rounded off to the nearest Rs.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple interest for 3 years @ 12% p.a. = Rs.6750

**Formulas used:**

Simple Interest = Principal × time × rate/100

Amount = Principal × (1 + r/100)t

Compound Interest = Amount - Principal

**Calculation:**

Rs.6750 = Principal × 3 × 12/100 

⇒ Principal = 6750 × 100/ 3 × 12 

⇒ Principal = Rs.18750

**For CI compounded half-yearly:**

Rate = 20%/2 = 10%

Time = 2 × 2 = 4 half years

Amount = 18750 × (1 + 10/100)⁴

⇒ 18750 × (110/100)⁴

⇒ 18750 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ Amount = Rs.27451.875 or 27452

Compound Interest = 27452 - 18750 = 8702

**∴ The required compound interest = Rs.8702**

questions.solution:

Radius + Height = 12.5 cm 

Total surface area of cylinder = 275 cm2

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of a closed cylinder = 2πRH + 2πR² 

⇒ 2πR (H + R)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 275 = 2 × 22/7 × R × (12.5) 

⇒ R = (275 × 7 × 10)/ 2 × 22 × 125

⇒ R = 3.5 

**∴ The radius of the cylinder is 3.5 cm.**

questions.question: The profit earned after selling an article for Rs.8,579 is the same as the loss incurred after selling the article for Rs.6,341. The profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP₁ = Rs.8579 

SP₂ = Rs.6341

**Formulas used:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

Loss = Cost price - Selling price 

Profit percent = Profit/Cost price × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the profit be = Rs.x 

CP₁ = CP₂

⇒ Rs.8579 - x = x + Rs.6341 

⇒ 8579 - 6341 = 2x 

⇒ x = 2238/2 

⇒ Profit = Rs.1119

⇒ Cost price = 8579 - 1119

⇒ Rs.7460

Profit percent = 1119/7460 × 100 

⇒ 15%

**∴ The required profit percent = 15%**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** When profit or loss is equal:

 Cost price = (SP₁ + SP₂)/2

⇒ (Rs.8579 + Rs.6341)/2 = Rs.7460

⇒ Loss = Rs.7460 - Rs.6341

⇒ Rs.1119 

**Profit % = 1119/7460 × 100 = 15%**
